title: Reader-output normalisation
finding: Normaliser version 2 removes reader markup from all five engines' output (Experiment 34 raw pages, 5 engines × 43 pages) and loses no visible character on any of 215 pages. Version 1 dropped image blocks with their text (protocol A2). Evidence for ADR-070 and TDR-028; shipped in `normalise-reader-markdown` (identity schema 6)
